THE SCENE

Your class is holding a trial about Americanization. Americanization means making newcomers learn English and American ways. You are the lawyer for the families. Your timeline has four empty dates. Four people can each give you one.

THE HISTORY

This trial is about Lemon Grove, a town in California. In 1931, Mexican American children were sent to a separate school. The town called it an Americanization school. Their families asked a judge for help, and the children won.
